title: 陽傘往左移一點
mood: a lazy afternoon off, in love
subject: moving the balcony parasol every twenty minutes on an afternoon off so the sun stays off a sleeping partner's face
caption: Mandarin bossa nova breeze pop. Nylon-string guitar in bossa comping with the thumb on beats one and three and syncopated chord pushes, cross-stick rim clicks and brushes, a shaker, a round mellow bass, and a flute answering the vocal lines, with a soft synth pad underneath. Close, dry and intimate, narrow, the guitar and the voice forward. Soft close-miked female voice, almost whispered, unhurried and sitting slightly behind the beat. 124 BPM, F major. A lazy afternoon off with someone you live with and like. No piano trio swing, no city-pop gloss, no electric guitar, no programmed drums, no lo-fi hip-hop beat, no belting, no autotune.
lyrics:
[Intro - nylon-string bossa comping and brushes]

[Verse 1]
放假的下午兩點 你說只躺五分鐘
陽台的折疊椅 你的腳伸到我這邊
小說蓋在你臉上 停在第十二頁
太陽慢慢爬過來 爬到你的耳朵

[Pre-Chorus]
我站起來 把陽傘往左移一點
你翻個身 說了一句我聽不懂的話

[Chorus]
陽傘往左移一點 影子剛好蓋住你
每二十分鐘 我就起來一次
冰咖啡的冰塊 一顆一顆化掉
我沒有叫醒你 我也哪裡都不想去

[Verse 2]
樓下有人在修機車 收音機開得很小聲
隔壁的貓走過欄杆 看了你一眼
四點半 太陽繞到晾衣架後面
陽傘跟著它 已經轉了快半圈

[Chorus]
陽傘往左移一點 影子剛好蓋住你
每二十分鐘 我就起來一次
你醒來第一句 問我現在幾點
我說 還早 其實天都快黑了

[Outro - flute answering, fading]
下次放假
換你幫我撐
